questions.text: A file of 12 megabits is sent over a link at an effective 3 megabits per second. Calculate the ideal time and explain why actual time may differ.

answer.text: Protocol overhead, congestion or retransmission can increase it

questions.text: Explain how parity can detect an error and give a limitation.

answer.text: A parity bit makes the number of 1s match an agreed parity
An even number of changed bits may go undetected

questions.text: Compare serial and parallel transmission for long distances.

answer.text: Serial sends bits sequentially; parallel uses several lines simultaneously
Parallel lines may suffer skew/interference; serial is often preferable over long distances
HTTP is used for web requests and responses
TLS encrypts communication and authenticates the server when certificates are verified
